description: A React component for displaying and managing a list of teams in the admin console, including pagination, search, and removal functionalities.

classes.name: TeamList
classes.description: A React component for listing and managing teams with pagination, search, and removal features.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial load of team data when component mounts.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of team data, optionally with a specified page size.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of team data.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of team data.

methods.name: getVisibleTotalCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of teams considering additions and removals.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Provides pagination details: start count, end count, total.

methods.name: removeTeam
methods.description: Removes a team from the list.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the data grid.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates the rows for the data grid based on current state and props.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input and triggers search action.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to props, especially search term changes.

methods.name: searchDebounced
methods.description: Debounced search function to optimize search calls.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the team list data grid component.
